podcast.title: The Dreaming (1982) Album Cover Appearance
podcast.body: Dell Palmer is featured on the cover of Kate Bush's fourth album, "The Dreaming," though only the side of his head is visible. He portrays the army officer whose head Kate holds, seemingly about to kiss him. "He's the army officer whose head Kate holds in her hands, apparently about to dive in for a kiss."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Death Details - January 5, 2024
podcast.body: Dell Palmer died at the age of 71 on January 5th, 2024. The cause of his death was never publicly disclosed. "He died at the age of 71 on January 5th, 2024."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Early Career Bands
podcast.body: Dell Palmer was involved with several bands during the late 1960s and early 1970s before his long-term collaboration with Kate Bush. "Dell went through a bunch of bands in the late 60s and early 1970s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Mentor to Kate Bush
podcast.body: In 1977, Dell became part of the KT Bush band, where he served as a guiding adult figure for the then 11-year-old Kate Bush during gigs in pubs. He continued as her bass player when she began her solo career. "Dell was one of the adults in the room, guiding her through gigs and pubs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Romantic Link to Kate Bush
podcast.body: Dell Palmer and Kate Bush were romantically linked in real life for a considerable period. "And yes, they were romantically linked in real life for a long time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Studio Engineer and Video Appearance
podcast.body: Beyond his role as bass player, Palmer worked as a studio engineer for several of Kate Bush's albums and made appearances in some of her music videos. "Here he'd work as a studio engineer for several of her albums and also appeared in a couple of her videos."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
